property_summary: Collect reverts exactly when either the caller has no initialized balance entry (unlockTime == 0 and balance == 0) or the preconditions (balance >= MinSum, balance >= amount, timestamp > unlockTime) are not all met, and if it succeeds the caller's balance decreases by amount and the contract's balance decreases by amount.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `Collect(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
